name: Group Life Insurance
description: Employer-paid death-in-service cover, usually a multiple of each employee's salary.

name: Group Health Insurance
description: Employer health scheme for staff and dependants, meeting UAE mandatory health insurance rules.

name: Home Buildings & Contents Insurance
description: Building and contents cover for owner-occupied villas and apartments, including alternative accommodation.

name: Home Contents Insurance
description: Contents and personal belongings for tenants and owners against fire, theft, water damage and accidental damage.

name: Critical Illness Protection
description: Lump sum on first diagnosis of a listed critical illness such as cancer, heart attack or stroke.

name: Term Life Protection
description: Level life cover for a fixed term of 10 to 30 years; pays a lump sum on death or terminal illness.

name: Unit-Linked Protection & Savings Plan
description: Regular-premium plan for 10 to 25 years combining life cover with savings invested in a choice of funds.

name: Essential Health Plan
description: Basic health cover meeting the Dubai Essential Benefits Plan, annual limit AED 150,000 within a restricted network.

name: Enhanced Family Health Plan
description: Family health cover with a wide UAE network, out-patient, maternity and dental benefits, annual limit up to AED 5,000,000.

name: Motor Comprehensive
description: Own damage, theft, fire and third-party liability, with agency or premier-garage repair and UAE-wide roadside assistance.

name: Motor Third Party Liability
description: UAE-compulsory cover for injury to others and damage to their property, with third-party property damage up to AED 2,000,000.

name: Personal Accident Cover
description: Lump sum for accidental death or permanent disability, worldwide, 24 hours a day.

name: Education Savings Plan
description: Regular savings towards a child's university fees, with life cover that keeps the plan going if the parent dies.

name: Regular Savings Plan
description: Flexible monthly savings for 10 to 25 years into a choice of funds, with a death benefit.

name: Single-Premium Investment Plan
description: One-off investment into a managed fund range with a death benefit; reviewed with the adviser every year.
